changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdentalprocedure AS SELECT dp.id, dp.patient_id, dp.encounter_id, dp.service_id, dp.procedure_id, dp.tooth_number, dp.surface, dp.anesthesia_used, dp.dose, dp.unit, dp.filling_material, dp.cdt_code_id, dp.notes, dp.created_by, dp.created_date, dp.last_modified_by, dp.last_modified_date, dp.is_cancelled, dp.cancelled_date, dp.cancelled_by, dp.cancellation_reason, dp.informed_consent_obtained, dp.treatment_outcome FROM public.dental_procedure dp;
